verdict: The agent applied H11, H12, H13, H14, H15, H16 (b) and H19 correctly in the files it changed, and it kept H1 to H10, E1, E8 to E10, F2 to F9 and D1 to D7. C carries `living` where it is defined, in 01, 06, COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION, ONE-ARGUMENT, the PLAN, the spine boxes and captions. Self-concern is defined in English as the anchor defines it. The path result has decided admission and admitted pairs, and 'one way' no longer labels it. The ranking stays on the condition read across all steps, which is what the theorems take. The persisting line is said as §4.9 proves it. 01's one-center sentence matches 07's thesis word for word and the Lean. Each Chinese sentence is right and reads naturally. It named no person and said the making once. It edited no verbatim, OPENING, AGENTS.md, goal, Lean or generated file, and it dropped no anchor or navigation line. I found and fixed four medium problems and four low ones. Each is listed below.

items.item: MEDIUM, fixed: AJ PLAN's new Reading said more than its home (07's opening, 'Within the whole map')
items.how: The agent's sentence read: condition 1 and the pooled couplings 'can be read as ways of making a loss return to the selector, closing relations'. That makes coupling a loss in close relations unconditionally. 07's reading says that they couple the loss into what a selection reads, and that relations close only 'where the selector is also affected, at some remove, by what it drains'. The agent's sentence also dropped 07's 'Coupling a loss in is not depending on it' and 'a rule that does not name a one-way dependent can still spare it' (H13). Re-said with 07's conditional and both limits: '…can be read as ways of making a loss return to the selector: they couple the loss into what a selection reads, and where the selector is also affected, at some remove, by what it drains, relations close and its own continuation reaches what it drains. Where relations close, read across all steps, a self-concerned order already ranks every widening above what it widens; where they cannot, for those whose loss never returns, counting their loss is the step offered. Coupling a loss in is not depending on it, and is not shown to make a selection respond to it; reach read across all steps does not say which differences reach which selection, when and how strongly; and a rule that does not name a one-way dependent can still spare it.'
